units.source_text: 老早以前，名人决胜棋限定的时间就特别长。

en.t: Long ago, the time limit set for the Meijin title match was especially long.

units.source_text: 大正十五年对雁金七段的弈战，是十六个小时。

en.t: In the match against Karigane 7-dan in Taisho 15, it was sixteen hours.

units.source_text: 雁金七段因超时而败北。

en.t: Karigane 7-dan lost because he exceeded the time limit.

units.source_text: 但是，即使黑还有时间，名人胜五六目，这棋局也是改变不了。

en.t: But even if Black had still had time, the Meijin's win by five or six points could not have been changed.

units.source_text: 人们也说，倘使没有时间限制，雁金七段应该下得更果敢。

en.t: People also said that if there had been no time limit, Karigane 7-dan would likely have played more boldly.

units.source_text: 同吴清源五段对局时，用时二十四小时。

en.t: When he played against Go Seigen 5-dan, the time allowed was twenty-four hours.
